The US-Iran MOU is off to a rocky start, as Vance (the fall guy?) spent the day defending the MOU with Iran and blasting Israel for not being fully on board.

What a turnaround on Israel. But remember, Vance speaks for his boss.

Israel was never on board with the deal.

So … Israeli air attacks on southern Lebanon have killed at least three people, Lebanese state media has reported, a day after the United States and Iran signed an interim agreement that called for an end to their war on all fronts, including Lebanon. https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/18/israeli-attacks-on-southern-lebanon-kill-three-despite-us-iran-deal

Therefore … Iran cancels talks that were to start in Switzerland.

And … Vance cancels trip to Switzerland.

https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/18/us/politics/vance-delays-trip-to-switzerland-for-direct-talks-on-iran-deal.html

The situation escalated further overnight as “The IDF struck over 80 Hezbollah targets across Lebanon overnight in response to repeated violations of the ceasefire by the terrorist group.” https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-899933

The White House responded with this –

The U.S. is being led by a bunch of maroons (we knew that) who have no idea what they are doing.

Or is there a deeper plan – to keep the war going, at least until November? And to keep moving stock markets?

The only thing these guys are good at is hurling juvenile insults.

It’s time to boot them out of office and hold them accountable.

Title cartoon by Clay Bennett at https://www.timesfreepress.com/news/2026/jun/18/memorandum-of-understanding/
